Principle 15: Whom Do I Admire?
A few years ago our country hosted the 2002 World Cup.
Our country’s soccer players are not one of the best teams.
Before the World Cup, soccer was not famous in our country.
Sports have a way of making new heroes and stars.
I would like to introduce to you one person
from the world of Korean soccer that I admire the most.
The person I admire the most is Guus Hiddink,
coach of the Korean Republic national soccer team from Holland.
During his time as coach of the Korean team,
he trained our soccer players very hard.
Even though Coach Hiddink spent a lot of time training
Korea’s soccer team, they were still not winning very many games.
Many people complained about him
and blamed him for the lack of success.
In spite of the lack of confidence in him by many Korean people,
he never lost his confidence.
He always emphasized that in order to be good players,
they must start from the basics.
By working hard and sticking to his plan
he was able to bring the Korean team to the semi-finals during
the 2002 World Cup.
In short, Coach Hiddink proved that he could succeed
despite Korea’s lack of confidence in his abilities.
